description: This PHP source file handles the creation and updating of calendar activity records within the vtiger CRM system. It processes form submissions for tasks and events, manages related contacts and invitees, handles status changes, follow-up creation, and redirects upon completion.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A class representing calendar activities (tasks and events) in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Gathers contact and related information for the activity, prepares email data.
